subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: What native backup exclude policy should OpenClaw support for `openclaw backup create` before accepting the linked implementation path?
rationale: The requested feature adds new CLI behavior that can reduce sensitive-file exposure and backup bloat, but defaults and protected-path exceptions affect restore reliability and security posture.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded native implementation
options.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR toward explicit exclude flags, protected recovery paths, tests, docs, and real backup proof.

options.title: Narrow to manual custom excludes only
options.body: Accept `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` without smart defaults until maintainers are comfortable defining built-in backup omissions.

options.title: Defer native excludes
options.body: Pause or reject native CLI work and point users to ClawHub backup tooling such as Keep My Claw while gathering more product evidence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded native implementation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR toward explicit exclude flags, protected recovery paths, tests, docs, and real backup proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main backup CLI/archive lines in this checkout trace to Vincent Koc, making them the best available routing candidate from local history.
